evidence: At baseline 952a618c LIB_DIR and NEW_KIND omit source talk. issue_body(..., 'talk', ...) therefore instructs lab.py new blog into library/ even though cmd_setup advertises source:talk and collect.py emits talk batches.
proposed_fix: Add talk -> library/talks/ and talk -> talk mappings; unit-test generated talk issue instructions.

evidence: At baseline 952a618c web maps to library/talks/ while NEW_KIND['web']='blog'. Web issue instructions therefore require a blog entry in the talks directory, conflicting with lab.py new blog output and PIPELINE.md.
proposed_fix: Map web to library/blogs/ and test the destination and new-kind agreement for every source.

evidence: None of these three mutation commands calls issue() or validates the active agent holder. cmd_release removes claimed unconditionally; cmd_done closes unconditionally. A different agent or stale owner can release/close another live claim. cmd_claim's replay also accepts any released by/done by comment without matching the winner.
proposed_fix: Centralize holder reconstruction and verify actor ownership before touch/release/done; ignore non-holder release/done comments in replay. Keep forced overrides explicit and auditable.

evidence: cmd_done checks only Path.exists() or git cat-file existence, then closes as completed. It never runs lab.py check or validates that supplied paths are library entries with the batch topic. Directories or unrelated files satisfy the local check despite PIPELINE.md's quality bar.
proposed_fix: Require regular library entry files, correct topic/type, and passing validation before closing; test directory/unrelated/invalid inputs. Do not alter existing entries.

evidence: cmd_publish reads ISSUES.tsv once, creates a remote issue, then appends the map after a second remote edit. Two worktrees with stale maps can both create the same batch issue, and a failure during the edit leaves an existing issue absent from the map.
proposed_fix: Before create, search remote open/closed issues for the deterministic batch marker; reconcile existing issue into the map. Add local atomic map updates and document residual cross-host race rather than claiming a local lock solves it.

evidence: The shared ledger spent() lock is released before the cap comparison and self.reserved update. Reservations are process-local and the whole check/update has no thread lock. Concurrent workers can admit requests against the same remaining dollars.
proposed_fix: Reserve under one ledger lock before dispatch and retain unresolved reservations; test two concurrent adapters against one cap.

evidence: Ledger construction uses if not exists followed by write_text without exclusive creation or locking. Two processes initializing the same missing ledger can overwrite reservations or spend written by the first.
proposed_fix: Create the initial ledger exclusively under a stable lock, never reset an existing file; concurrent-initialization test.

evidence: The retry loop reserves est and increments self.calls only once before all retries. Offline probe: two mocked HTTP503 dispatches consume self.calls=1. An ambiguous timeout can also be retried despite the repo no-ambiguous-retry rule.
proposed_fix: Disable ambiguous automatic retries; each permitted definitely-rejected retry needs a separate saved attempt and reservation/call count.

evidence: Reservation uses len(raw)/3+64 and configurable default prices .5/1 USD per million; provider request does not impose price ceilings. This is not a worst-case token/price envelope, and actual reported cost is applied only after dispatch.
proposed_fix: Validate finite nonnegative rates and bind a conservative byte-based envelope to enforced provider max_price; stop on reservation breaches.

evidence: Returned resp.model is never compared with the requested model. Offline synthetic response for other/model is accepted by an adapter requesting test/model. Per-call log also lacks returned model.
proposed_fix: Require and retain exact returned model/provider receipts; mark mismatch invalid without deleting the response.

evidence: base_url is arbitrary configuration and passes validation merely by starting https://; _request sends the OpenRouter key as Authorization to that host. HTTPS does not authorize a credential recipient.
proposed_fix: Allowlist the intended OpenRouter origin; require explicit independently scoped credentials for any additional endpoint.

evidence: HTTPError body is inserted verbatim into last and then ModelFailure. Provider/proxy bodies can echo request material; downstream worker retains exception text. Unlike factory.call, this adapter does not sanitize it.
proposed_fix: Record status and allowlisted error codes, redact any key/request material before retaining diagnostics; test a synthetic echoed-key body.

evidence: Ledger.add accepts negative/nonfinite deltas and rewrites spent without validation. Synthetic offline add(-.5,0) makes spent negative. The adapter also accepts configurable negative input/output prices, enabling negative reservations.
proposed_fix: Use explicit finite/nonnegative validations and typed settlement events; never let provider costs reduce aggregate spend below reserved/actual liability.

evidence: The script assigns total OpenRouter account usage minus one fixed baseline to this study and scales every model share proportionally. Wave3/4 factory and audit-gap now have independent paid authorization using the same account, so account deltas cannot identify this experiment or model.
proposed_fix: Keep original ledger immutable; reconcile only request IDs attributable to this study and report unallocated account deltas separately.

evidence: Sample-mode parser accepts c.startswith(w), while system asks exactly one allowed name. An answer beginning with an allowed name followed by an explanation or a contradictory second label is silently valid.
proposed_fix: Require exact normalized allowed-label equality or preregister any relaxed parser; test label+garbage and two-label responses.

evidence: Monthly spend is read once before creating a metered actor run. There is no shared reservation for pending runs. Parallel collectors can each satisfy spent+max_usd<=hard_cap and jointly exceed the monthly cap.
proposed_fix: Serialize metered admissions with durable pending reservations and account for unresolved runs; separate atomic admission from polling.

evidence: When a duplicate candidate has more likes, fresh[cid]=r replaces the scored survivor with an unscored raw row. The subsequent rows.sort reads r[score], causing KeyError, or carries stale score when supplied.
proposed_fix: Score the replacement and reapply min_score before replacing; fixture with duplicate IDs and increasing likes.

evidence: Batch filename chosen by exists() loop is then opened w, and SEEN.txt is appended later without a batch transaction. Concurrent batchers can choose the same filename and overwrite one batch, or a crash after batch write emits the same candidates next time.
proposed_fix: Exclusive-create batch files under a stable lock; derive/reconcile SEEN from committed batches on restart; concurrent/recovery tests.

evidence: max_usd and hard_cap are plain argparse floats with no finite/positive validation. NaN passes spent+max_usd > min(cap,hard_cap) comparisons and is forwarded as maxTotalChargeUsd=nan. Negative caps/budgets also accepted.
proposed_fix: Reject nonfinite/nonpositive budgets and invalid timeouts before reading credentials or dispatch; unit-test NaN/Inf/negative.

evidence: All Apify operations put token in query strings, including start/poll/dataset/abort URLs. This exposes credentials to URL logs and exception/request instrumentation unnecessarily.
proposed_fix: Use Authorization bearer header and remove token query parameters; test URL and diagnostics contain no synthetic credential.

evidence: tree_errors ignores checker returncode/stderr and only extracts stdout lines starting ERROR. Offline probe of returncode=1, stderr=Traceback, empty stdout returns an empty error set, approving a failed checker.
proposed_fix: Fail closed on nonzero exit or missing expected summary; retain sanitized diagnostic error and test crashing checker.

evidence: sync validates the candidate HEAD before entering its push loop, then git pull --no-rebase merges new main changes and pushes without validating the merged HEAD. Individually valid branches may introduce cross-file duplicates/gate failures only when combined.
proposed_fix: Re-run clean-tree validation after each successful pull and before every push; test a duplicate introduced by remote merge.

evidence: cmd_claim closure reads dependency statuses from the Lab snapshot loaded before mutate_task does git pull. A dependency released/reopened by that pull is still treated as done and the claim is admitted.
proposed_fix: Reload dependency documents from the fresh checkout inside every claim retry; test remote dependency status change.

evidence: Task claim/touch/done/release commit and push immediately without lab.py check, although AGENTS.md requires check before every push. done accepts outputs without existence/quality checks, so malformed task metadata can be pushed via the supposedly atomic path.
proposed_fix: Validate the exact task-mutation tree before push and require real output paths for done; retain no fabricated completion evidence.

evidence: Uses set -e without pipefail, and deployment is piped into tail -4. A failing wrangler exits the script successfully when tail succeeds, falsely reporting a published report.
proposed_fix: Enable set -euo pipefail and preserve deployment status; verify the deployed URL after success. For PR review use a copied version/new repo-owned wrapper, do not expose credentials.

evidence: check and verify failures are ignored, both piped to tail with no pipefail. if git push ... | tail -2 also tests tail rather than git push, so a rejected push takes the success exit and skips the five intended retries.
proposed_fix: Enable pipefail and explicitly abort on validation failures; test a mocked failed check and rejected push. Avoid changing active canonical checkout.

evidence: Minute cap checks used>=900 before determining the incoming clip duration. If used=899 and the clip is 120 minutes, the metered POST still runs and reaches 1019 minutes.
proposed_fix: Probe duration first and require used+ceil(duration/60)<=cap before dispatch; reject unknown duration.

evidence: Cap admission reads the JSONL log without a lock/reservation and logs minutes only after a successful response. Concurrent transcripts and ambiguous/failed POSTs therefore bypass cumulative liability accounting.
proposed_fix: Durable locked minute reservation before metered POST; failed/ambiguous requests retain liability until reconciled; no blind retries.

evidence: printf interpolates SRC directly into JSONL with %s; a local filename or URL containing a quote/backslash/newline corrupts the ledger. Next jq read fails and used defaults to 0, restoring the apparent entire allowance.
proposed_fix: Generate ledger rows with jq --arg or a JSON serializer and fail closed on malformed existing ledger rather than defaulting it to zero.

evidence: Source immutability, allowed model/route, max_calls/max_paid_usd, and finite nonnegative settlement checks use assert. python -O or PYTHONOPTIMIZE removes these admission/safety gates completely.
proposed_fix: Replace operational guards with explicit exceptions; run offline tests under both normal Python and -O.

evidence: futs=[...] then [f.result() for f in futs] raises at the first failed future while the remaining submitted futures can still make paid requests and mutate ctx. Worker records an invalid episode before these outcomes/charges finish, potentially overlapping the next episode.
proposed_fix: Drain all submitted futures and retain every outcome/cost before terminal episode write; stop further dispatch on budget failure and avoid changing finished ctx.

evidence: Current shared CI runs metadata/operations checks, but has no diff-based immutable-result guard. Existing result JSONL and frozen plan/ledger files can be overwritten in a green unrelated PR. Owner directives forbid changing them, yet the three PI-review reds requested by Wave5 are not mechanical admission checks.
proposed_fix: Add narrowly scoped diff-based immutable evidence guard with documented append-only and explicit correction exceptions; regression-test replacement versus new attempt files. Do not retroactively edit data.

evidence: All three invoke metered Apify actor.call without max_total_charge_usd, an account-spend admission check, or a cumulative reservation ledger. fetch_bundle launches up to eight actor runs concurrently. These alternate entry points bypass the bounded collector.
proposed_fix: Route all three through a shared capped collector admission layer and add a dry-run default. Shared-code fixes require original author credit in the PR.

evidence: The module reads a credential and picks.json, creates an ApifyClient and executes its thread pools at module import, with no __main__ guard. Tooling that imports the module to inspect/test helper functions unexpectedly launches paid runs.
proposed_fix: Move orchestration into main guarded by __name__, defer key loading until admitted execution, and test import with transport mocked to forbid calls.

evidence: The metered fallback admits whenever monthlyUsageUsd<4, without reserving the next charge or sending maxTotalChargeUsd. A near-cap run can overshoot and concurrent transcript requests can independently pass the same check.
proposed_fix: Use the shared Apify admission ledger and provider-side charge ceiling. Keep ambiguous run reservations; unit-test near-cap and simultaneous dispatch.

evidence: Lines 9-11 use export NAME=$(jq ...). export masks jq failure, as shellcheck SC2155 reports. Missing/malformed credentials leave partial environment and the script continues to wrangler; jq -r null is also accepted as an account/key string.
proposed_fix: Read each value with checked jq -er first, validate nonempty/non-null, then export separately; never print values.

evidence: Fetches messages?limit=20&after=last, then advances last directly to max returned ID without pagination. Discord returns latest-first; when >20 messages accumulate, earlier unseen messages are skipped permanently.
proposed_fix: Page the full unseen range in stable order before advancing per-channel cursor; offline fixture with 45 messages. Do not post or create new persistent jobs.

evidence: Resume keys only by task_id,seed and the output filename. It never compares old record configuration/backend/code/memory against current p. Reusing a path after a config or model change can silently skip new work or mix cohorts.
proposed_fix: Write/verify a frozen execution fingerprint before resume; require a new attempt path on changed model, params or runtime. Preserve existing records.

evidence: Resume declares a task complete when len(v)>=len(arms) and all rows are valid, not when each required arm appears exactly once. Duplicate valid records for one arm can satisfy the count while another arm is missing.
proposed_fix: Validate unique arm coverage and reject ambiguous duplicate histories; represent distinct attempts explicitly instead of collapsing them.

evidence: Resume reconstruction adds n/captured/frac_T/delta/calls from skipped complete records but never adds their cost_actual.cost_usd to stats.usd. Thus a resumed .summary.json/hub cost_usd reports only new costs, even while calls counts include prior work.
proposed_fix: Reconstruct all cost/outcome fields from original records and label cohort spend separately from cumulative shared ledger; regression-test interrupted/resumed summary equivalence.
